title: Pressflow calendar and release-notes sync for multi-channel product launch
creator: Asha Patel
description: Coordinated execution plan for the product feature launch across blog, email, social, and webinar channels, plus authoritative release notes. Objective: produce a single source of truth (Pressflow calendar) that syncs content owners, timelines, and gating approvals so cross-functional teams can execute simultaneously without last-minute changes. This ticket owns the calendar artifact, the release-notes canonical draft, and the handoff checklist for comms and support.
acceptance_criteria: Pressflow calendar published in Confluence with day-by-day tasks and assignees
Canonical release-notes draft reviewed and Approved by PM + eng + security
Assets (blog draft, email copy, social cards, webinar slides) each have an owner and delivery date in calendar
A single rollback/fallback messaging plan and support FAQ is included
All external publication times are scheduled in Marketing Hub and confirmed with infra for API quotas
